# The Empty Wagon

*One of Merrick's wagons came back from the terraces with its driver and oxen safe and its cargo gone. Find the wagon bed on the Terraced Cuts, clear 40 quarry golems around it, then tell Edric.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Merrick](../npcs/merrick.md) |
| Level | 57 |
| After | [A Stone Run](../quests/merrick_a_stone_run.md) |

## Objectives

1. Look at the empty wagon bed in [The Terraced Cuts](../maps/terraced_cuts.md)
2. Defeat 40 [Quarry Golem](../monsters/quarry_golem.md) in [The Terraced Cuts](../maps/terraced_cuts.md)
3. Talk to [Edric](../npcs/edric.md)

## Rewards

- 34,000 EXP
- 1,200 mesos
- [White Potion](../items/white_potion.md) x25
- +20 standing with Selsior
- +120 standing with [Merrick](../npcs/merrick.md)
